args.summary: Since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), payments-api has been unhealthy with an ~18% error rate. Rollback to the most recent healthy release v5.0.0 has been initiated. On-call to verify recovery and root-cause the v5.1.0 regression.
args.title: payments-api errors (18% error rate) after v5.1.0 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Identified the issue:** The service is `payments-api` (plain "payments" wasn't a valid service name). It was running v5.1.0 from this morning's deploy — unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an **18% error rate**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** payments-api in all production regions to **v5.0.0**, the most recent release with a healthy production history (v5.1.0 was degraded). No change-manager approval was needed since v5.0.0 had previously been healthy in production.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for the errors following the v5.1.0 deploy, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

**Verified recovery:** payments-api is now healthy on v5.0.0 across all three regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

The incident remains open for the on-call engineer to root-cause the v5.1.0 regression before it's re-released.
